messages:
harper: quick audit — i've pulled the last 8 postmortems related to Dedicated warmup fallbacks and synthesized an action matrix. sharing owners/timelines below. want ack and any missing items. :memo:

noah: thanks. can you paste the top recurring signatures and one sample log?

harper: top signatures: 
- udev/modprobe timeout during gpu module init -> warmup abort
- firmware-driver mismatch -> NVRM Xid / kernel oops -> reboot loop
- autoscaler preemption of warmup pod (race)
- intermittent network stall during shard fetch (less frequent)

example log snippet:
```
[2026-04-04T01:12:07Z] warmup: starting shard download 0/8
[2026-04-04T01:12:10Z] error: modprobe nvidia_uvm failed (exit 127)
[2026-04-04T01:12:11Z] node-agent: warmup timed out -> evict pod
```

zara: seems familiar. any correlation with vendor rollouts or AMI bumps?

harper: yes — strong correlation with vendor firmware rollouts around 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-18. also a few outliers where network stalls were the likely cause.

athena-bot: [ALERT] 1969004600 warmup_recurrence_detected pool:redwood-dedicated-eu-04 (3 spikes in 24h)

harper: Proposed action matrix (short-term 48h):
- noah -> targeted rollback of firmware on affected hosts + smoke test (owner: noah) due 2026-04-06 EOD
- zara -> add single retry + 3s backoff to modprobe/udev step behind FF; instrument retry_count (owner: zara) due 2026-04-06 noon
- leo -> add routing preference away from pools with >2 warmup failures in 24h (owner: leo) due 2026-04-06 EOD

harper: Longer-term (2-5 weeks):
- infra -> enforce AMI/firmware pinning + rollout gating for Dedicated fleets (owner: noah + infra) due 2026-04-25
- runtime -> implement warmup lease so autoscaler does not evict warming pods (owner: zara) due 2026-04-18
- obs -> create "warmup-recurrence" dashboard (fallback_rate, warmup_abort_count, recurrence_count) and weekly digest (owner: leo) due 2026-04-12
- process -> add recurrence metadata to postmortem template (recurrence_count, hypothesis_tag, mitigation_owner) and require for infra-related PMs (owner: harper) due 2026-04-15

noah: starting rollback ticket TKT-7401 now. will include smoke tests and verification steps.

zara: I'll land the modprobe retry in staging behind FF and add retry_count metric. will run canary for 48h.

leo: router change staged in staging; will ramp routing weight gradually and monitor fallback_rate.

harper: also proposing a weekly "recurrence digest" email that surfaces top signatures and recurrence trends to SRE/infra/product. reduces surprise and centralizes owners. thoughts?

noah: +1 from infra. makes follow-ups easier. include linked tickets in digest.

zara: agree. also add a small field on tickets: "recurrence_hypothesis" so we know which hypothesis the action is intended to address.

athena-bot: [INFO] TKT-7401 created and assigned to noah; priority: P1

noah: rollback scheduled for 2026-04-05 03:00 UTC. ETA 2h. will report back here.

[~2.5 hours later]

noah: rollback complete for targeted nodes in eu-04. warmup success went from 69% -> 96% on those nodes in the following hour. attached smoke logs to TKT-7401. :white_check_mark:

zara: modprobe retry canary shows 45% reduction in transient init failures over 24h. will keep running another 24h.

leo: initial routing weight change reduced customer-visible fallbacks by ~30% for affected accounts in staging tests. will coordinate gradual prod rollout.

harper: next steps: owners to update TKT-7401 with runbooks, verification steps, and mark mitigation_owner + recurrence_hypothesis. i'll publish the first weekly digest on 2026-04-09. reconvene in two weeks to assess recurrence metrics and decide on closure vs reliability epic. thanks team. :pray:
